name: Thorgrum Borrelson
summary: Above Thelsamar, Thorgrum Borrelson keeps travelers flying across Loch Modan. His roost links the valley with Ironforge and the nearby mountain passes.

sections.title: The Roost Above Thelsamar
sections.body: Thorgrum Borrelson keeps the gryphon roost on the bluff above Thelsamar. His trained gryphons carry the Alliance across Loch Modan, where troggs and gnoll packs threaten the roads. They pass through South Gate Pass to the Great Forge in Dun Morogh, then fly onward toward the Wetlands and beyond.

aliases: who is the gryphon master in thelsamar
faq.answer: Thorgrum Borrelson oversees Alliance gryphon flights from Thelsamar, carrying travelers into and out of Loch Modan.

aliases: where can i fly from loch modan
faq.answer: Thorgrum can send travelers from Thelsamar to Ironforge, Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands, Farholde Keep in the Riverglades, and outposts in neighboring territories.

faq.q: Why is gryphon travel important in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Troggs, gnolls, and Dark Iron scouts threaten Loch Modan's mountain passes. Gryphons let Alliance messengers, scouts, and adventurers cross the region quickly while avoiding those dangers.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can count on Thorgrum Borrelson to keep an aerial route open to Ironforge's high halls.
As an Alliance member, you can rely on Thorgrum's roost to link the dwarven realm with positions in the Wetlands and Arathi Highlands.
